historical_review_note: Exact prior selected review records retained as historical metadata. Primary, secondary and root adoption retain U for all four C016 members, describing broad rounded native features, neighboring shoulders/structure and weak diffuse trace-associated raw enhancement. All four own order-19 contexts retain true global-grid, original local-usable, original baseline-verified and later five-window mapping diagnostics. No other target or wavelength mapping limits or quality outcomes are inherited. Original epoch/raw evidence and a separate completed blue normalization context already used these observations; this is not blind or new observing evidence. No new raw-panel inspection or classification performed during input restoration.
